title: Ecology and life
about: The living city: a forest of trees as a population of individuals, its composition against declared limits, its carbon by declared allometry, its future under removals and planting; diversity and what a fuller count would find; how far apart its kinds are; any population by stages; occupancy, though not always seen; the canopy people live under, and how it holds together as habitat. The mathematics is the ecology domain's, on tyche's classes, peira's imperfect detection, calx's non-negative matrices and physis's circuits; the schemes it offers are declared files with their sources.
